title: Look at the sign
text: Again, $$y'$$ has the same sign as $$\sin{y}$$ whenever $$t$$ is not $$0$$.

title: Test values near $$0$$
text: When $$y$$ is small and positive, $$sin\left(y\right)>0$$ so $$y$$ moves up away from $$0$$. When $$y$$ is small and negative, $$sin\left(y\right)<0$$ so $$y$$ moves down away from $$0$$. So $$y=0$$ is unstable.
